exportLabel: Graded Wagers | All Action | This Week | November 1, 2026 5:24 PM
sheetNameNote: the workbook's single sheet is named after the agent login; that name is identity data and is not reproduced here
fileNote: The workbook itself is not committed: every row carries a customer login, a ticket number and a description. Only this shape is stored.
notes: It is a wager-level export, not the Analysis grid: five columns of one row per graded wager, where the Analysis results table renders seven aggregate columns per agent (All Players and Agents, Won, Lost, # of Bets, Risk, Net, Hold %age).
The 'This Week' label on the export is not a `week` parameter: the request sent a start/end date range and an empty `type`, so the week selector is resolved to dates before the call.
Every one of the 9,387 data rows has exactly five populated cells and a numeric Amount; there are no spacer or subtotal rows to skip.
